common_conditions: TS23.280 V19.9.0; single MC system; Stage2
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: MC service server or LMC subscribes using MC service IDs or group IDs
claims.conclusion: LMS checks LMC authorization; implicitly trusted MC service server need not be checked here. Group subscription obtains affiliation data from service server, maintains current affiliates after a successful group-dynamic-data subscription response, and updates target reporting configuration if needed. Location-subscription response indicates subscription status.

conditions: LMS has verified recipient's authorization to receive it
claims.conclusion: Configured trigger causes latest location notification. Group-based LMC subscription reports only currently affiliated users. MC service server does not receive optional UE label.

conditions: Authorized user has target MC service ID and its location subscriptions
claims.conclusion: LMS checks cancellation authorization; group cancellation also cancels group dynamic-data subscription and deletes its affiliated-member list. Cancel associated triggers from the same authorized user/server to the same targets, not every reporting trigger from everyone. Cancellation response indicates cancellation status.

limitations: Underlying group-dynamic-data protocol and full cancellation/configuration IE encoding not checked.
No equivalence to V19.10.1 editorial summaries is asserted.
